subject: Re: Kickoff: reference-less MT evaluation (Project Obsidian)
body:
Priya,

Staffing for Obsidian: Wei 60% as research lead, Saoirse 50% on the Evalline endpoint and serving path, Emeka 40% on data plumbing for the released annotations. Compute is trivial — CPU scoring, a couple of standard VMs.

The real constraint is the one you named: there's no open-source multilingual KB + entity-linking stack, which is exactly why the release ships pre-computed annotations instead of a linker. So we split the work: the Mar 20 reproduction and the May pilot both run on the released annotation files, while Wei scopes a replacement linker for candidate translations (that's the part we must run live at scoring time; source-side entities can be cached). His current candidate is a lightweight multilingual linker fine-tuned on our own KB snapshot — realistically a Q3 build, not this window.

Tomas cc'd: we'd like Evalline to treat KoBE as a metric plugin, same contract as the existing BLEU/chrF runners.

Deshawn
